## Activity

This report summarises activity at West Gate Eye Clinic for August 2024. The clinic recorded 26 captures during the reporting month. This figure represents the activity included in the site record and provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures below.

The activity measure is reported separately from the assessment outcomes. This allows the number of captures to be considered alongside the number that could not be assessed and the number identified as referable.

## Image quality

Image quality review found 4 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 15.4 of captures. These results are presented to show the proportion of recorded images that could not be graded and to support review of the overall site activity.

## Grading

Grading identified 6 referable results from the recorded activity. The median lag was 3. This measure records the middle value for the interval between capture and grading.

Together, the activity, image quality and grading measures provide a concise account of the site record for August 2024. The figures should be read as a combined summary: 26 captures, 4 ungradable captures, an ungradable rate of 15.4, 6 referable results and a median lag of 3.
